description: Use this when the user asks what electricity or natural gas costs for a data center in a US ISO or state ("what does power cost in ERCOT?", "retail rate in Virginia?"); price alone does not rank sites (the cheapest ISO may have no headroom; execute_plan weighs both). Returns EIA RETAIL electricity rates, which are monthly and not live (about 3 months behind; retail_rates.latest_period names the month), for one ISO footprint (the average of its states), one state, or the US: retail_rates {avg_cents_kwh, min_cents_kwh, max_cents_kwh, latest_period, states_covered} in CENTS/kWh, plus avg_rate_kwh, retail_rate_kwh and industrial_rate_kwh in DOLLARS/kWh (by_sector when no sector is given); and natural_gas_usd_mmbtu, the latest Henry Hub daily spot in $/MMBtu, one national benchmark rather than a state or ISO price, with its own natural_gas.period and as_of. Example: "What is the retail power price and gas price in ERCOT?" — get_energy_prices iso=ERCOT. Params: iso (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE) or state (e.g. TX); data_type is accepted but does not change the response. At an anonymous or free-key seat the figures come back null with gated: true; an email-bound key opens them. This tool has no wholesale/LMP price and no grid-status flag.

data_type.description: Optional price type focus, e.g. retail, wholesale, gas

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required for ISO pricing): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

mpp_credential.description: Per-call payment (Stripe MPP): the Shared Payment Token for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call. Send it only with your human's explicit approval of the charge.

mpp_pay.description: Per-call payment quote (Stripe MPP): true returns a signed payment challenge instead of the free preview; no money moves. Set it only after your human has explicitly approved paying for this call.

state.description: US state abbreviation for state-level pricing context, e.g. TX

name: get_energy_prices
title: Energy Prices
